title: [Staying Information API - PUT /api/traveler/request-bids/:id/staying-information] Malformed Guest Email ("invalid-email-format") Is Accepted and Persisted With HTTP 200 OK
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Prepare the complete valid staying-information fixture (fixtures/valid-staying-information.json) for open Customer Request #1514 with valid E.164 phone '+84900000000', fullName='QA Sample Guest', email='qa-sample@example.test', and valid emergencyContact.
Single-Variable Mutation: Clone fixtures/valid-staying-information.json and change ONLY stayingGuests[0].email to 'invalid-email-format' (fixtures/staying-information-invalid-email.json).
Execute GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids?requestStatus=open&locale=en-US readback to inspect persisted stayingGuests[0].email (then restore valid fixture).
actual_result:
- PUT /api/traveler/request-bids/1514/staying-information returns HTTP 200 OK ({"success": true, "message": "Update successful.", "data": {"acknowledged": true, "customerRequestId": 1514, ...}}).
- GET /api/traveler/request-bids?requestStatus=open&locale=en-US readback confirms malformed string 'invalid-email-format' was persisted in stayingGuests[0].email.
expected_result:
- Per GNS-FORM-001 Global Form Validation (Confluence 174227515), PUT /api/traveler/request-bids/:customerRequestId/staying-information must validate stayingGuests[].email format on the server and reject malformed emails with a 4xx validation error (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>).
- Invalid email strings must not be persisted on the Customer Request.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-008 | Single-Variable Delta: stayingGuests[0].email ('qa-sample@example.test' -> 'invalid-email-format') | Restored valid fixture after readback.
evidence.network: PUT https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids/1514/staying-information -> HTTP 200 OK; GET /api/traveler/request-bids?requestStatus=open&locale=en-US -> HTTP 200 OK returning stayingGuests[0].email='invalid-email-format'.
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 0v23-8ja2iskk.js validates guest contact inputs in UI, but Backend controller persists stayingGuests JSON without server-side email schema validation. | Security Classification: OWASP A06:2025 Insecure Design (CWE-602 Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security) & OWASP A10:2025 (CWE-754) | OWASP Remediation: Enforce strict server-side schema validation on nested stayingGuests[] and emergencyContact fields (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Input_Validation_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Missing Server-Side Email Validation on PUT /api/traveler/request-bids/:id/staying-information
reproducibility: Always (100% — single-variable mutation verified via GET readback on STAG)
